chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Abu Ubayda, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When Ali (peace be upon him) found two men in one quilt, naked, he would lash them with the penalty of the adulterer, one hundred lashes, each one of them, and similarly for the two women if they were found in one quilt, naked, he would lash each one of them one hundred lashes.
ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed punishment for two men or two women found naked together according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the hadd of one hundred lashes applies individually to each person found naked together, whether male or female, emphasizing the equality of the punishment in this specific context. This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the hadd for zina and other penalties, reinforcing the principle that the punishment is tied to the act of illicit sexual union rather than gender. It reflects the practical application of Quranic verses by the Ahl al-Bayt, ensuring precise judicial implementation of the prescribed limits.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws, whenever heasws found two men in one quilt, naked, would whip both of them the Penalty (Hadd) of the adultery, one hundred lashes, each one of them, and similarly for the two women if they were both found to be in one quilt, naked, would whip each one of them one hundred lashes’.
